decisions.title: Pin the devDependency to the reviewed release 1.4.0
decisions.rationale: package.json pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 1.3.0 for type checks and tests, while the managed host already runs 1.4.0 (~/.pi/agent/install/current-version). The extension API types are unchanged between the installed 1.3.0 and 1.4.0 releases (only agent-session, compaction, model-config, provider-composer, interactive-mode and pi-user-agent .d.ts files differ), so the bump is low risk. Same step as CU-04 of the 1.3.0 catch-up (ffd99fd1). CU-01.
decisions.verification: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.4.0 succeeded; package and both lockfile entries read 1.4.0. node scripts/test-work-ask-user.mjs, node scripts/test-work-compaction.mjs and node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs passed. Full verification authored-source TypeScript passed; unrelated limitations accepted in D5.

decisions.title: Compaction and branch summaries use the model's output limit; generateSummary(WithUsage) ignore reserveTokens (#9512)
decisions.rationale: Pi no longer sets a fixed maxTokens on summary requests, so long reasoning cannot cut a summary at the cap. work-models.ts summarizeNativeContext passes reserveTokens positionally to generateSummaryWithUsage; 1.4.0 keeps that parameter as _reserveTokens (compaction.d.ts:114) and the later positions (signal, customInstructions, previousSummary, streamFn, retry) are unchanged, so the call stays valid and the native and default modes get the fix for free. Keeping the argument keeps older Pi hosts (peerDependency "*") working.

decisions.title: Same fixed-cap pattern in ce-workflow's own hybrid compaction and vision calls
decisions.rationale: work-compaction-memory.ts:236 (maxTokens 16384) and work-vision.ts:56 (maxTokens 4096) still cap output while reasoning, the failure class Pi fixed. A search of every session log found no "Compaction response stopped: length" or "Vision model failed (length)" outside this review, and both paths fail safely (the next compaction model or local memory; a clear vision error). Raising the caps could raise cost with no observed failure. Revisit if a length stop appears.

decisions.title: Concurrent extension dialogs form a stack instead of replacing each other (#11166)
decisions.rationale: Pi now stacks select, confirm, input, editor and inline custom() dialogs so no promise is left pending. plan3.ts:690-697 serialUI works around exactly the old bug, but it stays: Pi's stack does not cover overlay custom() components, which ask_user uses by default; serialUI keeps first-in-first-out order for parallel requirement asks instead of newest-first; and it still protects older Pi hosts. Other concurrent dialogs benefit without changes.

decisions.title: Resume and /tree keep extension tools active unless registered with defaultActive: false (#11062, #11075)
decisions.rationale: The restore applies only to direct and model-only tools (agent-session.js _isActivatedOnRegistration). The opt-in camera tools (model-only) are re-synced by syncCameraTools on session_start and before_agent_start (work-models.ts:3651, 3697), so a restored camera tool is removed before the next request. plan3_design is deferred and unaffected. Every other ce-workflow tool is meant to be active.

decisions.title: Codemode waits for a free worker; PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS raises the limit (#11184)
decisions.rationale: Parallel codemode scripts and in-process subagents now queue for up to 60 s instead of failing. ce-workflow has no workaround to delete (no busy-worker handling or PI_CODEMODE references). The process_image wait in work-images.ts:137 handles a different race (a screenshot file not written yet).

decisions.title: Provider attribution headers come from pi-ai's client identity; before_provider_headers no longer sees them
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow registers no before_provider_headers handler and sets no User-Agent or attribution header.

decisions.title: Codemode models.classify() accepts images for Jev and Clef
decisions.rationale: jev-tools.ts sends typed questions about JSON and file text through registry.classify; image questions already go through process_image and the configured vision model. Nobody asked for image classification.

decisions.title: Extension loader exposes @earendil-works/pi-ai/models (#11156)
decisions.rationale: No ce-workflow extension imports @earendil-works/pi-ai.

decisions.title: Other 1.4.0 runtime fixes and additions
decisions.rationale: Recovery from responses cut at the output limit (#11227), grep --no-config, Windows shell detection, BOM-tolerant managed-install.json and mcp.json, terminal teardown, clipboard on Ctrl+Z, /compact instructions on split turns, retries, prompt-cache fix, Markdown and HTML rendering, Rex terminal, models.json reference, new and default models. None has a ce-workflow code path or workaround; the extension types.d.ts is identical between 1.3.0 and 1.4.0.

decisions.title: Verified private workflow generation
decisions.rationale: The official stable release is translated into the complete private nine-workflow generation with no ordinary CE runtime surface.

decisions.title: An idle parent is woken by the notice itself; no "Inspect subagent updates above" line (0.80.0)
decisions.rationale: work-compaction.ts:449-457 keeps the old wake texts so old sessions stay clean (D3 of ffd99fd1). The new wake is the notice, a role "custom" message, which gather() in work-compaction-memory.ts:83 never records as a user request. The hub has no wake-text handling. 0.80 needs Pi 1.2.0 or newer; the host runs 1.4.0.

decisions.title: Model-visible notices are wrapped in <pi_subagents_notice> by a context hook (0.81.0)
decisions.rationale: The wrapper changes only the provider request (src/extension/index.js:561-586); the stored transcript, customType and details stay the same, and ce-workflow's checks read those (work-compaction.ts:406, work-models.ts:831). The content-based check in isKnowledgeDiscovererCompletionMessage serves the retired knowledge discoverer, which has no production caller.

decisions.title: parallel, tasks and chain children accept per-child cwd and model (0.80.0)
decisions.rationale: Plan3 review launches one async subagent call per advisor (plan3.ts:575). Merging them into one tasks call would change how completions wake the parent and, under the Optimization Regression Rule in AGENTS.md, needs an end-to-end benchmark before it counts as an improvement. No problem with the current launches is reported.

decisions.title: providerDiagnostics on structured delegation :update and :response events (0.81.0)
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow uses only the v1 status RPC (plan3-web.ts:68) and has no view of child retry state; nobody asked for one.

decisions.title: A child with outputSchema that skips structured_output gets one follow-up turn (0.81.0)
decisions.rationale: The only subagent launch with outputSchema is the retired knowledge discoverer (work-models.ts:1229, no production caller). jev-tools.ts outputSchema is a tool result schema, not a subagent one.

decisions.title: Other 0.79.2 to 0.81.0 fixes and options
decisions.rationale: Faster Windows start and EPERM temp-folder fix, completion notices kept across a restart, steer fixes, children no longer get APPEND_SYSTEM.md, compacted sessions keep subagent, YAML frontmatter comments, enableSlashCommands, FleetView mouse support, Codex-wire tool ids. ce-workflow neither uses APPEND_SYSTEM.md nor sets enableSlashCommands, and none of these has a ce-workflow code path. The notice-across-restart fix helps hub-parked sessions without changes.

decisions.title: A top-level question sent with questions becomes the batch heading instead of an error (#80)
decisions.rationale: 0.17.0 shows that question as the batch heading (frame title, review page, dialog fallback, result text, call card) and no longer throws "Use exactly one of question or questions". Our vendored copy still throws it (extensions/ask-user/index.ts:2606-2611), and 15 earlier session files contain that error, each costing the model a retry. The hub batch form already renders ask.title as its heading (hub/web/prompts.ts:21), so passing the heading as title covers the browser too. CU-02.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-ask-user.mjs failed before port with exactly-one error, then passed heading result/details, terminal frame/review, fallback titles, call card, ask:pending title and hub payload assertions. node scripts/test-work-ask-remote.mjs passed. LSP inconclusive; authored-source TypeScript passed in npm run verify:quiet; unrelated suite limitations accepted in D5.

decisions.title: ask_user is registered with exposure "model-only"
decisions.rationale: Pi's extensions.md:270 says model-only is meant for tools that ask the user: declared to the model, never callable from codemode. A codemode script waiting on a dialog runs into script deadlines and holds a worker. ce-workflow's own callers use execute directly (registerAskUser for the Plan3 adapter) or the model, never codemode (rg tools.ask_user: none). One line. CU-03.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-ask-user.mjs passed including exposure=model-only, native single/batch remote races and D12 coexistence. Authored-source TypeScript passed in npm run verify:quiet; unrelated suite limitations accepted in D5.

decisions.title: ask-user.json settings file for display defaults (settings.ts)
decisions.rationale: Adds a second configuration source and an 81-line module next to the environment variables, which keep working. ce-workflow keeps its own settings; nobody asked for this file.

decisions.title: Tern native sheet (tern.ts) and the Space and Enter activate/submit refactor
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow targets the terminal and the hub, not Tern panes; the refactor only serves Tern's sheets and changes no terminal behavior. README and skill text changes describe these features; ce-workflow does not ship the upstream skill.

decisions.title: Mailbox: sends to a disconnected session report that the message waits; the broker stays up while mail waits; late messages emit expired
decisions.rationale: hub-command.ts intercomParkedSessions wakes a parked session before sending and only rewrites error results; a "waiting for reconnect" result is not an error. work-ask-remote.ts sends through intercom:outbox-request and does not read delivery text. No ce-workflow code depends on broker exit timing.

decisions.title: Click to expand or collapse one intercom message in fullscreen mode
decisions.rationale: Terminal display only; the hub renders its own chat.

decisions.title: Inherit pi-goal recovery, stale-context, settings, and documentation fixes
decisions.rationale: Grade: Not-our-problem. Reversibility: Tier 1 package rollback. Bottom line: keep pi-goal 0.54.8 package-owned and make no ce-workflow compatibility adapter. Verified project fit: ce-workflow's coexistence path only reads the canonical custom goal-state entry and sends public /goal pause and /goal resume commands; the installed persistence source still serializes data.goal under customType goal-state, and the public commands remain unchanged. Verified upstream evidence: the installed 0.54.8 README, managing-goals and settings references, package metadata, source, and captured 0.54.4-to-0.54.8 artifact show internal transient-stream classification, stale extension-context cancellation, menu/settings lifecycle, and documentation/build changes while preserving the coexistence surface. Benefit: pi-goal users receive safer recovery and lifecycle behavior without duplicate state ownership. Cost/risk: ordinary upstream regression exposure. Confidence: high. Recommendation: no local adapter.

decisions.title: 4.4.0 to 4.4.4: Pi 1.2 and 1.3 support, unavailable or disabled LSP reported as unconfirmed, read-guard, cascade and performance fixes; tool surface unchanged
decisions.rationale: Reviewed from the installed CHANGELOG.md because the diff artifact timed out. ce-workflow only names lens tools (read_symbol, read_enclosing, module_report, lens_diagnostics) for compaction classification (work-compaction.ts:237, 291-306; work-models.ts:1822). Those names and parameters are unchanged. Reporting a file no server answered for as unconfirmed matches the 4.3.0 decision not to treat inconclusive LSP results as clean. No local shim.
